name: Sleepless Shadows
detailed_description:
You hear a knock. You open your eyes and get out of bed. For several sleepless nights, the same thing has been happening: as soon as the rooms fill with darkness, something wakes up. It follows you, sometimes even speaks to you. It's driving you insane...

Gameplay

Explore gloomy rooms, light lamps to ward off creeping shadows hiding in the dark. But don't be fooled — you are not in control here. Real nightmares await you, and encountering them might be your last. Run, hide, find a secluded corner. If you are careful, you will understand what caused the appearance of night guests. Solve puzzles, find ways to leave this place, or huddle in a corner, hoping for mercy.

There's only one rule: don't let the character fall asleep...

Game Features

  • Non-linear gameplay and multiple endings. You are free in your actions, for example, there's a locked door in front of you, you can find the key... but why not break it with an axe?

  • A variety of puzzles and riddles.

  • A story hidden in the details.

  • Numerous terrifying monsters.

  • Atmospheric locations.

  • Appealing graphics and visual effects.

short_description: A nonlinear first person horror where you must never fall asleep under any circumstances, or those hiding in the shadows will take your soul. Don't trust your eyes – only light is your ally. Overcome challenges, solve puzzles, find the way out, or hide and await the end...
supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Russian
